title: Observation Receipt v1
description: Physical fact voucher for observed artifacts. Payload contains no self-referential fingerprint; envelope holds the TypedFP as WireDigest. Four-state model: SOURCE -> COMPILED -> OBSERVED (no decision). Per 02-evidence-receipt-and-ledger.md §2.

observationReceiptFP.description: TypedFP('rg.gatea.observation-receipt.v1', ObservationReceiptPayload) as WireDigest. Payload structure excludes this field to prevent self-referential hashing.

observedAt.description: Observation timestamp; observable only, not used by verifier for decision

status.description: Four-state model: OBSERVED state with no decision field. Semantic verifier: clockUsage=false, randomUsage=false, networkUsage=false per READ_CATALOG_ONLY policy.
